property_summary: For any address caller equal to the current owner, calling setOwner(newOwner) succeeds and updates owner to newOwner in the reference; the mutant inverts the guard and will revert such calls, so the property is that owner can call setOwner to change owner (caller==owner implies call succeeds and owner becomes the supplied address).
change_summary: Replace require(msg.sender == owner); with require(msg.sender != owner); in onlyOwner, reversing the guard so only non-owners can call setOwner.
